basis: Owner generalization clarification on 2026-11-16; existing v0.5 and v0.6 tasks
interpretation: Synthetic variants are required regression evidence, not proof of every live account or unseen issuer DOM. Source contract, live completeness and issuer-confirmed action evidence remain required. No task is completed by this matrix.

cases.expected: Discover source inventory without an owner count or four-card assumption; empty requires explicit source proof; limit crossings remain incomplete rather than silently omitted.

variations.product_names: generated after adapter design; no catalog match required

cases.expected: Read benefits and rewards for unfamiliar source products; fallback artwork does not remove cards or destinations.
Identity follows verified source bindings; only complete correctly scoped coverage permits removal.

variations.distinct_cards: two or more with an equal display ending

cases.expected: Keep cards, sections, destinations and preferences separate; display ending alone is not unique identity.
Discover the union of accessible cards, deduplicate only proven same-card identities and preserve other connections after partial reads.
Traverse observed loading paths; report complete only with source proof and retain earlier data on incomplete reads.
Vary content independently from owner captures; crossing a transport bound must not become an all-benefits completion claim.
Discover current issuer offers without a merchant allowlist; preserve confirmed history and distinguish absence, expiry and unknown freshness.
Default-on processing makes and separately confirms one addition per independently eligible card; shared display text or campaign alone never suppresses another card.
Reconcile the same proven card and offer across connections; do not create duplicate actions for that same target.
Use issuer-confirmed exact-card results, reconcile uncertainty before resending and leave genuine restrictions pending without forcing actions.
Automatic eligible adding defaults on in production; pause/off stop future actions; capture and test modes never mutate issuer offers.
